title: A failed older page of a comment thread is re-requested at round-trip speed
trigger: Open a channel post's comments (or a group reply thread), scroll to the top of the loaded replies so the older page is requested, and have getMessageThreadHistory fail (network error, swept as lost after its TTL, or a persistent TDLib error such as losing access to the discussion group).
effect: fail_thread only records a failure for the newer side (newer_failed) or for a thread that is not Ready yet. An older-page failure of a Ready thread leaves no mark, loaded_complete stays false, and fetch_thread_history (called from maybe_auto_load_older on every render with row 0 shown, and from preload_history_by_scroll) sends the same page again as soon as the answer lands: a request loop with no Retry row, unlike the main history's load_failed.
fix: Give each end of the thread window a page state (Idle | Loading{request} | Failed) on TopicHistory, set Failed in fail_thread for the older end and have fetch_thread_history wait for an explicit Retry, as the main history's load_failed does.

title: A failed older page of a forum topic is re-requested in a loop
trigger: Open a forum topic with messages loaded, scroll to the top so GetTopicHistory asks for an older page, and have it fail (network error, a 408 from the sweep, or a persistent error).
effect: fail_topic_page marks topic_load_failed, but topic_history_load_failed only counts it while the topic has no messages, so fetch_topic_history's guard ignores it and maybe_auto_load_older (called each render while row 0 is shown) sends the page again as soon as the error lands. The pane shows no error and the request repeats while the user stays at the top.
fix: Track the older end's fetch as one value per topic window (Idle | Loading | Failed) and stop auto-paging in Failed until a Retry, instead of a failure set that only the first page reads.

title: A late Gifts page for another chat overwrites the open gallery's Gifts next_offset
trigger: Open the shared media gallery of user A on the Gifts tab, then before its receivedGifts page lands open the profile gallery of user B (or another channel); A's page lands after B's first page.
effect: accept_profile rejects A's items (chat mismatch), but apply_profile_gifts writes page.next_offset into the in-place gallery's Gifts tab unconditionally, so B's tab pages on with A's offset: Load more in B fetches from the wrong offset (skipped or repeated gifts, or the list ends early).
fix: Move next_offset into accept_profile behind the same chat check (or carry the gallery generation on GetProfileGifts like the message tabs) so a rejected page writes nothing.

title: Profile tabs (Stories, Gifts) accept pages from a closed and reopened gallery
trigger: Open the Gifts tab of a chat, scroll so a second page (append) is in flight, close the gallery and reopen it for the same chat before the page lands.
effect: Profile tabs are matched by open + chat_id only, never by the tab generation that open_for_tab restamps, so the old append page is added to the fresh tab: page-2 gifts show alone before the first page, or are duplicated after it, and next_offset comes from the stale page.
fix: Stamp GetProfileGifts / GetChatPostedToChatPageStories with the tab's generation (begin_profile_fetch restamps, begin_profile_more keeps it) and accept only matching answers, as the message tabs do.

title: A deletion in another chat marks the in-chat search jump as missing
trigger: In a supergroup, search inside the chat and jump to a result (jump Loading or Ready on message id N). Meanwhile a message with the same id N is deleted for good in another supergroup or channel (server message ids repeat across channels).
effect: miss_search_jump compares only message ids, not ChatSearchState::chat_id, so the jump turns Missing and the status line says the message is unavailable for a message that still exists.
fix: Pass the chat id of the deletion and change the jump only when search.chat_search.chat_id matches; better, make the jump carry its ChatMessage key.

title: Answers stamped with a closed chat window land in a new window for the same chat
trigger: Open chat X in its own window, start a view request there (shared media, calendar, message-by-date, thread history, sponsored rows), close the window and reopen X in a window before the answer lands.
effect: PendingRequest::window is the chat id, which repeats: apply_payload_in_asking_view finds window_chats contains X again and applies the old window's answer to the new window's fresh view. Most view states have their own stamp, but any that match only by chat (sponsored rows, date jump, Instant View) take it.
fix: Key window views by a per-open window token (or bump a view epoch in open_window_chat) and stamp requests with it, so a reopened window never takes the closed one's answers.

title: attachment_menu_toggled and data_sent are not matched to the flow that asked
trigger: Start adding bot B to the attachment menu from a link (awaiting_toggle set, toggle in flight) while a Remove from menu for bot A (from its profile) is also in flight, and A's answer lands first; or send data from mini app A, close it and open keyboard mini app B before A's answer lands.
effect: poll_mini_app_session ignores the bot id in Ok((_, added)) and takes awaiting_toggle on any toggle answer, so B launches before its own toggle answered and the wrong Added/Removed toast shows; data_sent carries no app at all, so B's flow reports A's result.
fix: Make each one-shot answer carry the request id (or bot id) it answers and take awaiting_toggle only when it matches, as attachment_menu_bot and found already do with the bot id.

title: A stale public-forwards page is appended to a freshly reopened post's statistics
trigger: Open Message Statistics for post A, load more public forwards, and while page 2 is in flight open post B's statistics and then post A's again.
effect: begin_message gives A a fresh empty state, and the in-flight page-2 answer (matched by chat and message only) is appended to it: page 2's forwards show without page 1, next_offset continues past them, and message_forwards_loaded now reports loaded so page 1 is never asked.
fix: Record the forwards request id (or the offset it asked) in the list and accept only the answer to it; dropping the state for another post should also forget its request.

title: Story insights forwards accept any page for the same story, including a stale append
trigger: Open story statistics, load more public forwards, switch to another story's statistics and back while the page is in flight.
effect: accept_public_forwards matches by (chat, story) only and extends the fresh list, so a page from the earlier visit lands without page 1; a reopen while a page is in flight also never sets forwards_loading on the new state.
fix: Keep the forwards fetch as one value with the request id (Idle | Loading{request,offset} | Failed) and accept only its answer.

title: The story editor's Save reads the shared StoryManageState slot, so another call's outcome closes or fails it
trigger: Edit a posted story in the composer and press Save; while editStory is in flight, another management call takes the slot (the viewer's cover or privacy editor, or an album action that calls fail_locally).
effect: frame_upkeep clears save_sent when stories.manage.pending is false, without checking that the slot still holds this edit's request. The other call's result decides: its success closes the composer as saved while the edit may still fail silently, its failure shows its error in the composer.
fix: Keep the edit's RequestId in the composer (a Saving{request} stage) and settle it only from the answer to that request, not from the shared slot's pending flag.

title: Clips keep being assigned to a sticker worker that has ended
trigger: A sticker worker or opener thread ends (a panic in decode or packing caught by spawn_guarded).
effect: WorkerEnd only sets worker_gone, which wait_idle reads; open() still picks workers from the fixed `live` list, so new clips land on the dead worker and stay Opening with busy set forever, and clips it owned never get frames. Stickers and custom emoji on that worker stay blank until restart.
fix: Track each worker's liveness in State (Running | Gone) and, when one ends, mark its clips Failed (or reassign them) and leave it out of open()'s choice.

title: A frame ThorVG fails to draw is asked for again on every tick
trigger: A TGS sticker whose frames ThorVG cannot render (render returns an error for some frame) is on screen.
effect: frame() delivers nothing and leaves the clip Ready; the view keeps wanting that frame, so the worker retries the failing render on every UI tick while the view waits on a frame that never comes.
fix: Turn a failed draw into ClipState::Failed (or a per-frame failed mark) so views rest and the frame is not asked again.

title: ThreadView's load stage is status plus three bools kept in step by hand
trigger: Any thread open: needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed are set by the reducer and cleared by the driver around ThreadStatus.
effect: Combinations like LoadingHistory + reading_started with no request in flight are representable: start_thread_in_open_chat sets reading_started before fetch_thread_history, so a send error leaves the thread loading with nothing to retry it (plausible stuck spinner).
fix: One enum: Resolving{request} | SwitchingChat | Starting | LoadingFirst{request} | Ready | ReloadNeeded | Failed(String), each with what leaves it.

title: Shared media tab: status enum plus loading_more bool and an error string
trigger: Any gallery tab paging older items.
effect: loading_more is a second stage beside status (only meaningful when Ready) and error is filled beside Failed by hand; begin_fetch, accept, fail, accept_more and the profile paths each reset a different subset.
fix: Fold into one enum: Idle | Loading | Ready{more: Idle|Loading|Failed} | Empty | Failed(String).

title: SharedMediaState: open bool and chat_id Option change together
trigger: Gallery open/close.
effect: open and chat_id (and playlist_user) are set and cleared together by hand in open_for_tab and close; accepts() checks both.
fix: Replace with gallery: Option<OpenGallery{chat_id, active_tab, tabs, playlist_user, selection}>.

title: Playlist fetch is loaded/loading/error/stale bools
trigger: The profile's saved music.
effect: loaded, loading, error and stale are set by hand in fetch_playlist, apply_profile_audios, fail_profile_audios and take_stale_playlists; an append failure sets error beside loaded tracks.
fix: Use Fetch<…> for the first page plus a separate more-page state, with Stale as a variant that the driver turns into Loading.

title: PublicForwardsList loading bool beside error Option
trigger: Message statistics forwards paging.
effect: Both can be set; forwards_requested and fail_message_forwards keep them in step by hand.
fix: A page enum (Idle | Loading{request} | Failed(String)) next to the accumulated forwards.

title: Story insights forwards and the public story search hold loading bools beside error Options
trigger: Story statistics forwards; public story search paging.
effect: StoryInsightsState::forwards_loading/forwards_error and StorySearchState::loading/error/request are three fields of one stage kept in step by hand.
fix: One page enum per list: Idle | Loading{request} | Failed(String).

title: StoryManageState: pending bool duplicates request Option
trigger: editStory / editStoryCover / setStoryPrivacySettings.
effect: pending is true exactly when request is Some; start, settle and fail_locally keep both in step. The slot is shared by the composer, the viewer's editors and albums, which read pending without a request.
fix: enum ManageCall { Idle, Pending{request, story}, Failed{story, error} }, and callers keep their own request id.

title: StoryViewersState loading bool beside error Option
trigger: Story viewers panel paging.
effect: loading and error are a stage held as two fields.
fix: A page enum (Idle | Loading{request} | Failed(String)).

title: StoryPostState one-shot answers (eligibility, check_error, outcome) are unkeyed
trigger: Story composer check and post.
effect: The composer clears eligibility/check_error/outcome before asking and then waits for any of them to fill; nothing ties the answer to the canPostStory/postStory it sent.
fix: Carry the request id in a Checking{request}/Posting{request} stage and settle only from that answer.

title: StoryComposer stages are check_sent, post_sent, save_sent bools plus local_error
trigger: Story composer post or edit.
effect: Three in-flight bools and an error are cleared by frame upkeep reading session slots; nothing prevents two set at once, and edit_target/repost_source/as_chat_id form a second implicit mode.
fix: enum ComposerStage { Editing, Checking{request}, Posting{request}, Saving{request}, Failed(String) } and enum ComposerMode { New, Edit(story), Repost(story) }.

title: StickerPanel load stages are a cluster of bools and options
trigger: Sticker panel installed sets, selected set, attached sets, suggestions.
effect: loading_sets/installed_loaded/failed, loading_set/set_request/failed_set_id/loaded_set_id, greeting_loaded, suggest_waiting_for_sets and the *_stale flags are each kept in step by hand across connect, error and session code.
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> for the installed sets and one SetLoad enum (None | Loading{request,set} | Loaded(set) | Failed(set)) for the selected set.

title: GifPanel holds loaded/loading/failed and search_loading/search_failed/search_mode
trigger: GIF panel saved list and search.
effect: Two fetches (saved, search) are each three bools plus a mode bool, reset field by field in gifs.rs and session_stickers.rs.
fix: enum GifView { Saved(Fetch<Vec<AnimationItem>>), Search{query, page: Fetch<..>} }.

title: WebApps grossing_loading bool beside grossing_bots Option
trigger: Apps tab.
effect: A Fetch held as a bool plus an Option (failure is an empty Some); the one-shot answer slots beside it are a second pattern of unkeyed results.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the grossing bots.

title: A clip's stage is origin Option, busy, drawing, delivered and state together
trigger: Every sticker clip.
effect: origin Some means waiting to open, busy means a worker holds it (open or frame), drawing names the frame, and state is Opening/Ready/Failed; next_job, next_decode, worker::frame and opener::open each update a different subset.
fix: enum ClipStage { Waiting(Origin), Opening, Ready{drawing: Option<u32>}, Failed(String) } owned by the engine.

title: PlayHead started bool duplicates last Option
trigger: Every sticker view.
effect: started is true exactly when last is Some; start and restart keep both.
fix: enum PlayHead { Waiting, Playing{pos, last} }.

title: StripPull expanded bool beside reveal Option
trigger: Stories strip pull-down.
effect: reveal Some implies expanded; the methods keep the pair in step.
fix: enum StripPull { Collapsed, Revealing(Reveal), Expanded }.

title: Joined-or-joining a video chat is read off four sources
trigger: Video chat join.
effect: call.is_joined, call.need_rejoin, reconnecting(), the UI's joining Option and a pending JoinVideoChat request together form the join stage; each caller passes the UI half in.
fix: One join stage on the tracked call: Idle | Joining{request} | Joined | Rejoining.

title: A message translation in flight lives in two maps kept in step
trigger: Translate a message.
effect: jobs holds the request and messages holds Translation::Pending for the same key; begin, finish, abandon and forget_message_translations must change both.
fix: Keep the job id inside Translation::Pending{job} and drop the separate jobs map for message targets.

title: A topic window's paging stage is spread over flags, a stale set and a session-wide failure set
trigger: Forum topic paging.
effect: loaded_complete, has_newer, newer_failed, stale_pages, history_pruning.gone_topic_pages and threads.topic_load_failed together describe each end's fetch.
fix: Per end: enum EndState { Complete, More, Loading{request}, Failed }, with stale requests dropped by request id on the window.

title: updateDefaultBackground with a null background fails to parse, so a removed default wallpaper is never applied
trigger: On another device (or another Quill session on the same account) remove the default chat wallpaper (deleteDefaultBackground / reset to no wallpaper). TDLib sends updateDefaultBackground with background:null.
effect: parse_chats_payload returns MissingField for the update, the envelope is dropped, and Session::chats_state.default_backgrounds keeps the old wallpaper: Quill keeps drawing the removed default wallpaper until restart. (Quill's own delete_default_background removes the entry optimistically and never restores it when TDLib refuses, the mirror-image leftover.)
fix: Make UpdateDefaultBackground carry Option<Background> and have the reducer remove the theme's entry on None; keep the optimistic delete as a pending value restored on the error arm.

title: The system proxy step's result is read from the shared ProxyState::error, not matched to its request
trigger: Use system proxy settings with an OS proxy set. Quill sends a system step (addProxy/editProxy); TDLib refuses it, which sets settings.proxy.error and marks the list stale, so system_proxy_tick returns early until the refetch lands. During that window open Settings > Proxy and save or enable a custom proxy (send_proxy_mutation clears error), and let that call fail.
effect: Before the refetch the proxy box shows an error for a change the user never made; then the user's own failure is taken by system_proxy_tick (error.take()) as the system step's refusal, so the box loses the user's error, the system step is marked refused (waits RETRY = 5 min), or, if the user's call succeeded, the refused system step is resent at once. system_proxy_tick also writes error = None before every send, wiping any error the box is showing.
fix: Give system steps their own RequestPurpose (or keep the RequestId in SentStep) and settle SentStep from that request's answer; never read or clear the user-facing ProxyState::error from the tick.

title: SentStep holds its stage as two bools (refused, settled) beside an Instant
trigger: Code reading: system_proxy_tick sets settled=true then refused from a side channel; refused without settled is meaningless.
effect: Three valid stages (in flight, settled ok, refused at time T) encoded as four bool combinations kept in step by hand in connect/proxy.rs.
fix: enum SentStepState { InFlight { request: RequestId }, Done, Refused { at: Instant } } inside SentStep { step, state }.

title: LinuxState keeps the background accent read's stage as value + running + failed
trigger: Code reading: linux_cached, ReadDone::drop and the spawn closure each write a subset of the three fields.
effect: Idle / Reading / Read(value) / Failed are spread over Option<u32> and two bools; ReadDone and the closure both write failed, and a successful read leaves the state Idle-with-value, so every later read() (the minute timer, window activation, and the poll's own read() right after the read lands) spawns gdbus+gsettings again; the read started from inside the poll's update is never applied until the next refresh.
fix: enum AccentRead { Idle { last: Option<u32> }, Reading { last: Option<u32> }, Failed }; read() starts a read only from Idle and only when asked to refresh, not on every cached lookup.

title: StoryPageOp: one session-wide slot for every chat's page loads and mutations, with request: Option beside the state
trigger: Code reading: Session::stories.page_op is overwritten by begin_story_page_op / begin_story_page_check for any chat; send_story_page sets Failed with request Some(extra) after taking the request back.
effect: A mutation replaces an in-flight page load's Checking op (the load is then no longer seen as loading), a load for chat B replaces chat A's; request is Option although Checking/Sending always need it.
fix: enum StoryPageOpState { Checking { request, chat, purpose }, Sending { request, chat, purpose }, Succeeded, Failed(String) }, with loads tracked per (chat, purpose) apart from the single mutation status.

title: "Page is loading" is checked by op label only, not by chat, so paging for one chat is skipped while another chat's page loads
trigger: Open chat A's story page and scroll the archive to its end (getChatArchivedStories in flight, page_op Checking 'loading archived stories'); before it answers, open chat B's story page and scroll its archive to the end. Or start an album mutation while a page loads.
effect: ui/story_albums/paging.rs story_page_loading() matches op.label == story_page_op_label(purpose), so B's next page is not asked until A's answer clears the op (self-corrects on the next scroll); a mutation started mid-load makes the load look finished and the same page is asked twice.
fix: Key the load-in-flight check by (chat, purpose, request) instead of the label string.

title: StoryPlayback keeps Stopped/Running/Paused as two Options (started, paused_since)
trigger: Code reading: set_paused only sets paused_since when started is Some; stop clears both by hand.
effect: paused_since is meaningful only while started is Some; the invariant is kept by hand in start/stop/set_paused.
fix: enum StoryPlayback { Stopped, Running { started: Instant }, Paused { started: Instant, since: Instant } }.

title: StoryViewerItem says 'live' three times: kind == Live, is_live and live_call
trigger: Code reading: story_viewer_item sets kind, is_live and live_call together for each content arm.
effect: Three fields must agree (kind Live <=> is_live <=> live_call Some); duration_secs/video_file_id are likewise only meaningful for Video.
fix: Make StoryViewerKind carry its data: Photo, Video { duration_secs, clip }, Live(LiveStoryCall), Unsupported; derive is_live from it.

title: SuggestedPostsState::busy is a hand-kept mirror of in-flight approve/decline requests
trigger: Code reading: connect/suggested_posts.rs inserts on send; the reducer removes on ok, on error and on any updateMessageSuggestedPostInfo for that message.
effect: The set duplicates Session::requests (which already knows the purpose and key) and can disagree with it.
fix: Derive 'busy' from Session::requests (has a pending SuggestedPost Approve/Decline with that key) and drop the set.

title: An offer update clears the busy mark while its approve/decline is still in flight, re-arming the buttons
trigger: As a channel admin press Accept on a suggested post; before the approveSuggestedPost ok arrives, an updateMessageSuggestedPostInfo for that message lands (e.g. the member edits the price), then press Accept again.
effect: apply_suggested_post removes (chat, message) from busy on InfoUpdated, so send_suggested lets a second approve/decline go out while the first is pending; the second gets an error toast or acts on changed terms.
fix: Clear busy only from the request's own answer (ok/error), or derive it from the pending request table.

title: ParsedCall carries ReadyParams beside CallState instead of inside CallState::Ready
trigger: Code reading: parse_call fills ready only for callStateReady; session_calls.rs copies it into the active call only when state is Ready and keeps it through HangingUp.
effect: state and ready must agree by hand; the active call keeps the old ReadyParams (emojis, is_group_call_supported) after it leaves Ready.
fix: CallState::Ready(ReadyParams); the active call keeps its connection params in its own stage enum.

title: ParsedGroupCallParticipant keeps video_enabled/screen_sharing_enabled bools beside the Option video infos they mirror
trigger: Code reading: both are derived from the same JSON field in parse_group_call_participant.
effect: Two representations of one fact that callers may read inconsistently after a partial merge.
fix: Drop the bools and use video_info.is_some() / screen_sharing_video_info.is_some().

title: ParsedChatMember spreads per-status data over status + five Options/bools
trigger: Code reading: admin_can_post_messages, admin_can_invite_users, admin_rights, can_be_edited only mean something for Administrator; restriction only for Restricted.
effect: Fields that belong to one status variant are carried for every status and must be kept consistent by the parser and every merge.
fix: enum MemberStatus { Creator { anonymous }, Administrator { rights, can_be_edited }, Member, Restricted(MemberRestriction), Left, Banned, Unknown }.

title: ChatDraft holds text vs rich as two fields and the reply as three loose fields
trigger: Code reading: parse_chat_draft sets text empty when rich is Some; quote and item are meaningful only with reply_to_message_id Some.
effect: Mutually exclusive content and a reply split across reply_to_message_id/quote/item that must change together.
fix: enum DraftContent { Text(String), Rich(RichDraft) } and reply: Option<DraftReply { message_id, quote, item }>.

title: ReceiveBridge lifecycle is spread over shutdown/stopped flags, thread: Option and route: Option
trigger: Code reading: shutdown() stores the flag, joins the thread and takes the route; StopGuard sets stopped only without shutdown; is_joined reads both Options.
effect: Running / ShuttingDown / Stopped / StoppedUnexpectedly are encoded across two atomics and two Options (a routed bridge never uses its shutdown flag).
fix: enum BridgeFeed { Injected { thread, shutdown }, Routed { hub, client_id }, Closed } plus one atomic stop reason shared with the loop.

title: updateChatReplyMarkup is dropped whole when its message fails to parse, leaving the old keyboard
trigger: A bot sends a new reply keyboard attached to a message whose content Quill's parse_message rejects (an unsupported or malformed field).
effect: parse_message(m)? fails the whole update (no @extra, so it is not recovered); the chat keeps showing the previous bot keyboard (or none) until the chat is reloaded.
fix: Parse only reply_markup and id from reply_markup_message, or degrade to message_id with no markup instead of failing the update.

title: An unparsable last message in updateChatLastMessage becomes 'no last message'
trigger: Receive a new message whose JSON parse_message rejects in any chat.
effect: parse_message(..).ok() turns the failure into last_message: None, which the reducer applies as the chat having no last message: the row's preview and date go blank until another message arrives.
fix: Distinguish 'null' from 'failed to parse' (Result or a separate variant) and keep the old preview on a parse failure.

title: A macOS text-replacement answer is matched to the composer by text prefix only, not by chat
trigger: macOS, text replacements on: type a shortcut and a space in chat A, and switch to chat B in the same window before NSSpellChecker answers, where B's draft starts with the same text.
effect: apply_system_text_replace (ui/composer_system_replace.rs) checks only that the composer's prefix equals Check::prefix, so the replacement is applied to chat B's draft.
fix: Carry the chat/topic key (AccountChat) in Check and apply the answer only while that chat's composer is the one shown.

title: updateChatPendingJoinRequests with a null pending_join_requests is a parse error, so the join-requests bar never clears
trigger: Be an admin of a group or channel with 'Approve new members' on and one pending join request, so the bar shows '1 request to join'. Approve or dismiss that request in Quill (one request, not 'all'), or let another admin or your phone handle it, or let the requester cancel. TDLib sends updateChatPendingJoinRequests with pending_join_requests: null (schema td_api.tl:11466 'may be null').
effect: The parser calls int53(None)? on total_count, returns MissingField, and copy_and_parse drops the update (an update has no @extra to recover). groups.pending_join_request_counts keeps the old count, so the bar stays with the old count and avatars. Opening it shows an empty list. Only 'approve all' (ProcessAllChatJoinRequests, session_apply_ok.rs:719) or a new request clears it; a single approve (forget_join_request) never touches the count. The bar stays until restart.
fix: Parse a null or absent pending_join_requests as total_count 0 with no user ids (UpdateChatPendingJoinRequests { total_count: 0, user_ids: vec![] }), and treat only a missing chat_id as a parse error.

title: A messageEffect answer that parse_message_effect rejects becomes Unknown, so the effect id stays 'requested' forever
trigger: Open a chat with a message whose effect TDLib describes with a messageEffectType* constructor Quill does not know (or with id 0). load_message_effects sends getMessageEffect and calls mark_requested(effect_id). The answer reaches 'messageEffect' => None => return Ok(None), so it falls through to EnvelopePayload::Unknown.
effect: The Unknown arm only logs. MessageEffects::requested keeps the id, it never goes to by_id or failed, and wanted() skips it from then on. The effect never plays and is never asked for again. is_gone() stays false, so anything waiting on it keeps waiting until restart.
fix: Return Err(ParseError::MissingField) for a messageEffect the parser rejects. recover_failed_response then sends the request a synthetic error and StickersPurpose::GetMessageEffect fails the id. Better still, keep the effect's lookup as one enum per id (Requested/Ready/Gone) in place of three sets.

title: ParsedMessage keeps the send stage as send_state plus a separate can_retry flag
trigger: n/a: can_retry means something only when send_state is Failed, and the two are parsed and stored side by side.
effect: No bug today. A reducer that copies one field without the other, for example on updateMessageSendSucceeded or an optimistic resend, can leave can_retry true on a Sent or Pending message.
fix: Put can_retry inside the variant: MessageSendState::Failed { can_retry: bool }.

title: One MessageTopic sum is split over four fields, two of which are duplicates
trigger: n/a: message.topic_id is parsed into ParsedMessage::topic_id, ParsedMessage::thread_id, MessageExtras::forum_topic_id (a second copy of topic_id) and MessageExtras::direct_messages_topic_id (0 = none).
effect: No bug today. Four values must agree on which variant is active, and a writer that updates one copy, for example a topic move or an edit, can leave the other copy stale.
fix: Use one `topic: Option<MessageTopic>` enum (Forum(i32) / Thread(i64) / DirectMessages(i64) / SavedMessages).

title: MessageReplyTo encodes 'reply to message' versus 'reply to story' with sentinels (message_id 0 / story_id 0)
trigger: n/a: a story reply has message_id 0 and story_id > 0, and every message-only field (quote, origin, content) is left empty by hand.
effect: No bug today. A reader that checks message_id alone treats a story reply as a reply to message 0 in the poster's chat.
fix: Use enum ReplyTarget { Message { chat_id, message_id, quote, origin, content, .. }, Story { poster_chat_id, story_id } }.

title: A file's download stage is three bools and a path (LocalFileState) plus an uploading flag
trigger: n/a: is_downloading_active, is_downloading_completed, path and can_be_downloaded together encode idle/downloading/complete, and usable_path() and is_idle_incomplete() rebuild the stage by hand.
effect: No bug in the parser. Every UI reader re-derives the stage, and active+completed or completed with an empty path are representable.
fix: Parse into enum LocalFile { Absent { can_download }, Downloading { downloaded_size }, Complete { path } } with an Uploading stage on ParsedFile.

title: A checklist task's done state is completed_by plus completion_date kept in step
trigger: n/a: is_done() reads only completion_date != 0 while completed_by is a separate Option.
effect: No bug today. An optimistic toggle that sets one field without the other shows a task done with no author, or with an author but not done.
fix: Use `completion: Option<TaskCompletion { by: Option<MessageSender>, date: i32 }>`.

title: One chosen story reaction is split into reaction_emoji and reaction_extra Options
trigger: n/a: parse_story_chosen_reaction returns (emoji, extra) and both are stored. ParsedStory::chosen_reaction_emoji/extra has the same shape.
effect: No bug today. Both can be Some, and a writer that sets one must clear the other by hand.
fix: Use `reaction: Option<ReactionType>` (or a StoryReaction enum).

title: Self-destruct 'not opened yet' versus 'counting down' is a sentinel expires_in_ms == 0
trigger: n/a: MessageSelfDestruct uses expires_in_ms 0 for 'not scheduled', and fetched_at_ms (wall clock at parse) has meaning only in the counting stage.
effect: No bug today. remaining_secs reads the sentinel by hand, and the struct stamps a wall-clock time even when nothing is counting.
fix: Use enum SelfDestructClock { NotOpened, Counting { expires_in_ms, fetched_at_ms } } inside MessageSelfDestruct.

title: Own admin rights are eight Option<bool> fields beside ChannelMemberStatus, kept in step with it
trigger: n/a: UpdateSupergroup and Supergroup carry status plus can_restrict/invite/promote/manage_tags/manage_topics/change_info/send_welcome/manage_video_chats as Option<bool>, None meaning 'not an administrator'. UpdateBasicGroup flattens three of them to bool with unwrap_or(false).
effect: No bug in the parser. Each consumer must agree that None means 'not an administrator' and that the creator has every right. A status change applied without the rights, or the reverse, leaves the rights stale.
fix: Carry the rights inside the status: ChannelMemberStatus::Administrator { rights: AdminRights, .. }, with one rights() accessor that returns all rights for Creator.

title: requires_premium and premium_animation are two copies of one fact that can disagree
trigger: n/a: requires_premium is true when full_type.premium_animation is non-null, while premium_animation is None when that file fails to parse or has id 0.
effect: No bug confirmed. A Premium sticker can be gated as Premium yet have no effect file, and a reader that checks premium_animation.is_some() reaches the opposite answer.
fix: Keep one `premium: Option<PremiumSticker { animation: Option<FileId> }>` field.

title: Payment receipt Total leaves out the tip and the shipping cost
trigger: Pay a bot invoice with a tip (or a flexible invoice with a paid shipping option), then open the receipt from the 'Payment successful' service message.
effect: The receipt's Total row shows only the sum of invoice.price_parts; the tip is listed on its own row but not added, and shipping_option.price_parts are dropped entirely, so the Total is less than what the card was charged.
fix: In parse_payment_receipt sum invoice.price_parts + shipping_option.price_parts + tip_amount (as tdesktop does), or keep the parts and let the dialog compute the total from all three.

title: currency_exponent misses zero-decimal currencies Telegram uses (ISK)
trigger: Open an invoice, checkout or receipt priced in Icelandic krona (ISK), which Telegram's currency table lists with exponent 0.
effect: The amount is divided by 100 and shown as e.g. 'ISK 19.99' instead of 'ISK 1999', so the price shown before paying is wrong.
fix: Take the exponent table from Telegram's currencies.json (the list tdesktop and the Bot API use) instead of a hand-kept ISO list, and test it against that file.

title: Process-wide LAUNCH_CHATS stage is moved by any client's Ready, not the on-screen client's
trigger: Launch with two accounts where the background account's TDLib reports authorizationStateReady before the on-screen account has opened its database.
effect: The stage goes to ASKED for a page nobody asked for, so the first frame (macOS) blocks the main thread up to the 50 ms cap waiting for the on-screen page that is still far off; the design says a client still opening its database is not waited for.
fix: Key the launch wait to the client id that registered the on_ready launch request (store it in LaunchChats when load_chats_when_ready runs) and ignore other clients' auth states.

title: Name accent palette is one process-wide table written by every account's session
trigger: Have a production account and a test-DC account signed in (or two accounts whose servers send different updateAccentColors); the background account's updateAccentColors arrives last.
effect: Names on the account on screen are painted with the other account's server palette (ids 7+), and the table only corrects when the on-screen account's next updateAccentColors arrives.
fix: Keep the palette in each Session (it is per-server config) and pass the on-screen session's palette to the renderer, or key PALETTE by AccountKey.

title: Replacing a stopped hub leaves every existing client unrouted on the dead hub's routing table
trigger: The receive thread gives up after MAX_CONSECUTIVE_PANICS; the user then adds an account or reconnects, which calls TdHub::shared and builds a new hub with an empty Routes table.
effect: The old clients' TDLib instances stay open (their envelopes are now dropped as unrouted-client), their bridges report stopped, and reconnecting the same account opens a second TDLib instance on the same database directory, which TDLib refuses while the first holds the lock; the account stays failed until restart.
fix: Keep one Routes (and MAY_BE_OPEN list) for the process and hand it to the replacement hub, so live clients keep their routes across a receive-thread restart.

title: Gift purchase offer stage held as a bare u8 (0 pending, 1 accepted, 2 rejected)
trigger: n/a
effect: No bug today; service_text matches the numbers by hand and any new TDLib giftPurchaseOfferState silently reads as pending.
fix: enum GiftOfferState { Pending, Accepted, Rejected, Unknown } parsed from giftPurchaseOfferState*.

title: Story's chosen reaction split into two Options that must never both be Some
trigger: n/a
effect: No bug today (only the parser writes them, and it sets at most one), but the type allows an emoji and a custom/paid reaction at once and readers check them separately.
fix: chosen_reaction: Option<ReactionType> (the type message reactions already use).

title: GroupCallCrypto bound/unbound stage is an AtomicI32 0-sentinel plus a separate hiding_log AtomicBool kept in step by bind/unbind/Drop
trigger: n/a
effect: No bug found; bind hides the request log then stores the id, unbind clears the id then shows the log, and Drop repeats the show, so the two atomics carry one stage by hand.
fix: One Mutex<CryptoStage> enum { Unbound, Bound { group_call_id, log_hidden: HideGuard } } where the guard's Drop restores the log level; frames read the id under the lock or via an ArcSwap.
